name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
about: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Limited, incorporated in 2011, is engaged in the business of manufacturing, designing, building and servicing technologically advanced products and systems for the electricity network. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Port Portfolio
The product portfolio of the Co. includes Transformers, Power Transformers, Switchgears (Primary & Secondary Switchgears), Medium Voltage Switchgear, Protection Relays, Differential Relay, Electricity distribution management systems, a software suite for self-healing smart grid, e-House & smart cities applications. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 59.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 109%
cons: Stock is trading at 26.0 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
